label: Late-sequence: <DEL> of long sequences and late copy steps
explanation: Update-gate unit driven by absolute position late in the sequence. Never fires in the original phase (5 of 646k steps). Fires on the <DEL> step for long sequences (21% of delimiter steps overall, rising with L: ~0 for L<=6, 18% at t=9 i.e. L=9; delimiter holds 43% of mass and the max activations). In the copy phase, rate rises steeply with absolute t (4% at t=10-11, 26% at t=15, 57% at t=17), so mostly the final outputs of L=8-9 sequences. At mid copy steps (t=12-15) it prefers certain input tokens (2, o, u, p, 3, k; 2 and o have ~3-4x lift). Does not fire on short sequences (L<=5) at all. Precision is limited: even at <DEL> with L=9 only a minority of sequences activate, and the token dependence is not cleanly captured.
